title: Maternal Social Dominance Orientation, Maternal Conformity-related Socialization Goals, and Young Children’s Ethnic Prejudice
descriptions: Data of the manuscript titled: Maternal Social Dominance Orientation, Maternal Conformity-related Socialization Goals, and Young Children’s Ethnic Prejudice.The sample includes White Dutch, Turkish-Dutch, and Afro-Dutch families (mothers and children).
